Our Nordic locations Explore program From key Nordic cities, our community supports every stage of the entrepreneurial journey, from startups to international success. With more than 5.000 members and over 100.000 annual users, we are one of the largest startup communities in the Nordic region. Our goal is to create the best startup locations, valuable recruiting and funding services to accelerate the Nordic startup scene.
